entry.title: New: Resolution 32 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL, HAWAIʻI CRIMINAL JUSTICE DATA CENTER, PURSUANT TO HAWAIʻI REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY POLICE DEPARTMENT

Allows for the receipt of $318,240 of federally-derived funds to enhance the department’s Records Section to improve accuracy, quality, timeliness, immediate accessibility, and integration of national systems of criminal history and related records.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 32-25 & FC-3 - 1/22/25
